description: Insert (or replace, with force: true) a typed entry in compose/CHANGELOG.md. Idempotent on (date_or_version, code) at storage level; optional caller-supplied idempotency_key for retry safety. Audit-log append is best-effort. Use this instead of editing CHANGELOG.md by hand.

body.description: Free paragraphs between header and labeled subsections.

code.description: Feature code (e.g. "COMP-FOO-1"). Uppercase A-Z, digits, dashes; cannot start or end with a dash.

force.description: If true and an entry with the same (date_or_version, code) exists, replace it in place.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Same key replays return the cached result without re-mutating.

sections.description: Optional labeled subsections; emitted in fixed order Added → Changed → Fixed → Snapshot.

summary.description: One-line summary; renders as the "— summary" tail of the entry header.

name: add_changelog_entry
